title: Testing of residues excavated from Wanggou urn burials, Zhengzhou
version: China National Silk Museum 2017 annual report, pp. 44–45. Section 郑州汪沟遗址出土瓮棺残留物测试.
lineage: Original museum laboratory reporting on the Wanggou urn samples. The 2019 Xinhua account reports the museum and excavation team's findings, so it is not independent identification of the silk.

passages.locator: pp. 44–45 (PDF p. 32), testing of residues from the Wanggou urn burials
passages.note: The team examined fifteen samples from W12 and W20 together. Carbonised fabric in W12 showed two structures, a coarser plain weave and a finer crossed-warp weave tentatively described as leno. The ELISA result identifies the latter as silk. The report does not provide the calibrated date of W12.
